# MemUnmap

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Removes a mapping made by MemMap() or MemMapAnon().

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_UNMAP (1)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err MemUnmap(void *va);
```

**Registers:** `(va) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `va` | in | Start address of the mapping. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOENT`](../errors.md#err_noent) | No mapping contains `va`. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `va` is not the start of its mapping. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | The mapping is pinned (for example the syspage). |
